entities.name: Henry Torrès
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Henry Torrès was a French trial lawyer and politician, and a prolific writer on political and legal matters. A left-wing politician and a member of the French Communist Party before World War II, he was a Gaullist in the Post-War period.
